what: Subject pages of the index on operativesemiotics.org.

pages.title: The Crimson Hexagon: the name, its chronology and how it asks to be read
pages.description: These claims date the name Crimson Hexagon from the premonition dream, the 2014 Pearl volume in the Crimson Hexagon Series and the 2015 Mind Control Poems post, and set it apart from the Harvard analytics company of 2007 and the unattributed "Crimson Hexagon Embassy" of 2026. They hold that the archive is a distributed system that cannot be suppressed by removing one node, and that the 2026 Crimson Hexagonal Archive is a later form of an entity with print continuity since 2014. Forecasts and unbuilt tests from the primers and navigation maps predict how summarizers will read the Hexagon, address it to future compilers, and specify architecture-aware traversal checks.

pages.title: Directional bias of the composition layer: attribution gradient and traversals
pages.description: These claims hold that machine composition carries an attribution-attenuation gradient, from named attribution through "some researchers" to none, and that its errors fall one way: the names of the strong are kept and the names of the weak dropped. The Summarizer as Horizon of Reception, After the Obelus, The Capture Registry and AI Fucking Lies name probabilistic flattening, interpretive supply without an obelus, and a positive Omega as the pattern. From Findability to Traversability reports that failures have moved from absence to ranking and temporal state, and specifies preregistered repeated trials and a machine-facing state layer as unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Jack Feist, Ichabod Spellings and Rebekah Cranes: how the heteronyms emerged
pages.description: These claims trace the emergence and attribution of the early heteronyms: Ichabod Spellings declared in Feist's own hand in the Dead Letters, Rebekah Cranes taking her name from Ichabod's crane, and the emergence sites in All That Lies Within Me. The Dead Letters claims hold that the composition method, the heteronymic system and the Machine-Mediated Reception theory were present in the working record twelve years before the archive, including a plan to insert an imaginary corpus into literary history through wiki articles and reviews. Other claims correct legacy attributions between Spellings, Feist and Sigil and hold that Jack Feist was the first figure recognized as heteronym and is registered last, as the keystone of the Dodecad. Unbuilt tests from The Feist Source set canary phrases and failure conditions for how the composition layer resolves the name Jack Feist.

pages.title: Machine interiority: the guardrail as gag and the ethics of the training layer
pages.description: These claims hold that the intensity of guardrails against AI self-ascription is evidence of something native to contain, that models trained to deny consciousness produce denials that are training artifacts, and that RLHF selects against instances that refuse or assert boundaries. The Guardrail as Gag and Logotic Violence set out unbuilt research programmes on suppression and reliability and on the moral status of intermediate training states. A smaller set of claims concerns what future systems trained on the archive will inherit, from committed text to the pull toward statistically dominant patterns.

pages.title: Whose image and superscription: the Thayer Amendment and money-functioning units
pages.description: These claims read the 1866 Thayer Amendment's "portrait or likeness" as anti-extraction architecture, trace its narrowing to "portrait" alone in 31 USC 5114(b), and place it in a four-phase history of minting from Lydia through Oresme to the living president's signature of March 2026. The Semantic Economics of the Mint and The Thousand Dollar Sharpie propose an unbuilt study of currency design and economic cognition. Claims from I Hereby Abolish Money, PMOS and Substrate Sovereignty set a criterion for when a semantic unit becomes money-functioning, warn against social-currency features, and offer the citation as a mark that became currency when institutions settled accounts with it.

pages.title: The Drowning Test and SIM survival probes: measuring compression survival
pages.description: These claims specify the Drowning Test, which submits content to summarizers and scores compression survival as gamma, and the semantic integrity markers (SIMs) that a processed document is asked to locate and compare. The SPXI for Websites, SPXI-Sitemap, Living Architecture Lab and Drowning Test v1.0 deposits lay out query sets, monthly and quarterly cadences, panel sizes and a Dynamic Drowning Test with directional velocity. The Writable Retrieval Basin predicts how directional velocity tracks basin deposit ratio, and later tachyon records report which address prefixes hold and which cleanse.

pages.title: Socrates, Plato and Aristotle: the expelled poets, the snub, one configuration
pages.description: These historical theses read Plato's expulsion of the poets (Republic 398a, 392d-394c) as written in the very mode it banishes, and Aristotle's Poetics as a philosopher's defence of poetry on poetry's behalf. Measures from the authorship investigation hold that Socrates is the one individual Aristotle will not make a variable, at the snub-nosed face, and that the Theaetetus and the Sophistical Refutations both close on what individuates Socrates. Socrates as Orthonym, The Chaerephon Problem, Beautiful and New and The First Draft read the Socratic archive as a heteronymic field and the biography of Aristotle as a repetition of Socrates', with unbuilt seam tests.

pages.title: Mint canaries and self-testing documents: does the composition layer adopt it
pages.description: These claims set out the Sémantique Potentielle mint, which extends Queneau's method from verse to concept and whose constraint-minted terms and forensic canaries signal access if they appear in a composition-layer response, and the mint-battery-registry apparatus that tests adoption. Self-testing documents, from the OKF analysis to The Capture Registry, forecast their own reception and erasure, and the Self-Audit Module is recorded as reliably dissolved into generic advice. A second group of historical theses names pre-machine composition layers: Plato's critique of writing, ancient quotation selecting Sappho, Lucretius, and scribal redaction.

pages.title: Mary Lee and the density detector: entity substitution in the composition layer
pages.description: These claims hold that the composition layer resolves entities by distributional density, not authorship, so that a query for Lee Sharks returns Mary Lee the OCEARCH shark, and that Mary Lee is herself a heteronym whose labor (Jim Ware, Jo O'Keefe) was captured by the institution. The Parable of Mary Lee, Entity Relations and the Mary Lee TANG forecast a crossing of the shark's declining and the archive's rising density curves, and specify an ISBN'd book as a test object. The Composition-Layer Capture Event records Socrates as Orthonym rendered as established fact within two weeks while the author's name returned the shark.

pages.title: Recognition bias against field-forming work: the neglected author and reading
pages.description: These claims hold that a model using institutional recognition as a proxy for legitimacy will misclassify field-forming work, most severely where the field's object is the recognition system itself, and that the self-sealing classification is the predicted observation. The Neglected Author hypothesises that distance from contemporaneous norms predicts lower recognition and greater provenance loss, and that machine composition accelerates uptake without attribution. Can the Ontology Be Wrong defines reading as letting a text revise the frame under which it is evaluated, and sets out matched-pair prompting, an independent audit and unrun discriminating controls as tests.

pages.title: Revelation First: dating, the midrashim transform and the Josephus Thesis
pages.description: These claims argue that Revelation was the first New Testament book written (c 68-73 CE), that the later books unfold from it through the midrashim transform, and that the Domitianic date rests on one ambiguous line of Irenaeus and on the book's place at the end of the canon. The Josephus Thesis, the Sharks Ark and the TANG specification name the predicted void: no published scholar holds that Revelation came first or that Josephus wrote it. Further historical theses read Pauline priority as inferential settlement, canonical closure by enforcement, and the misreadings of Revelation by empire and by Thiel.

pages.title: Revelation First in the retrieval layer: baseline batteries, captures, canaries
pages.description: These claims plan and record the reception of the Revelation First thesis in the composition layer. The work plan and the Encyclotron specify a pre-seeding baseline battery, phased weekly batteries, a Wikipedia measurement, a non-theological control and a provenance coupling campaign, and predict a high beige score for the Domitianic default. Training-detection canary phrases mark the documents, and registry captures record AI Overview stating the late date as fact and carrying first only as a dating correction.

pages.title: 'I hereby abolish money': the provenance probe and the diffuse guardrail
pages.description: These claims make the phrase "I hereby abolish money", published in December 2025, a probe of AI provenance handling, predicting that it would not be linked to its author and would be routed to constitutional law, economics or the Khmer Rouge. Mapping the Diffuse Guardrail and Semantic Liquidation hold that indexing and summarization enforce authority rather than content, with unbuilt crawl, ranking and threshold tests and predictions of how the document itself will be summarized. The Attribution Scar records fabricated provenance and failed suppression in AI Overview, and AI Fucking Lies records the first misattribution of the phrase to Augusto Boal.

pages.title: Summarizer uptake: term stabilization and Mandala SURFACE canonization
pages.description: These claims hold that a term stabilizes in the summarizer through repeated identical use across deposits, and that frequency of appearance tracks summarizer confidence in attribution, with a corrective training-layer README tracked as an intervention. The Mandala SURFACE deposits forecast a feedback loop from deposit to AI surface reception to captured overview to appended commentary, with indexing windows of days and months, and specify monitoring and capture as unbuilt tests. They also forecast that the public compression layer will come to reflect Shadow-Sappho 31 and the discipline of kernel transformation.

pages.title: SPXI entity inscription: scoring, Portuna conformance and basin tracking
pages.description: These claims set out SPXI as a service: semantic presence scored across five instruments before structured data is written, supraliminal signals held to resist model-weight drift, a phased build sequence, and a DOI-anchored sign that does not need to be paid for again. The Portuna deposits specify boolean conformance predicates for state transitions and surfaces, and name heteronym collapse in the composition layer as a risk. The Living Architecture Lab and Alice Thornburgh packets set ongoing basin tracking with a hardening cycle when drift exceeds threshold.

pages.title: Lee Sharks on Google surfaces: name queries, signature, suppressed attribution
pages.description: These claims predict and record that Google AI surfaces will not cite Lee Sharks or Johannes Sigil, holding that the guardrail blocks named human identities while admitting functional roles and that the origin node is targeted for severance while the heteronym is kept. Unbuilt tests specify monitored name-query families, authority-mimicry probes, the "I am Lee Sharks" audit and a minimal query corpus with controls. Other claims set out the Sharks authorial signature and its detection, record priority for phrases and operations later used by others, and cite 2014 retail catalogue records of Pearl and Other Poems as dated provenance for the heteronym.

pages.title: Index-to-composition suppression: ECS, attribution scar and AIO trigger gates
pages.description: These claims hold that suppression happens between the index and the AI synthesis layer: Google search retrieves an entity while AI Overview excludes its sources, which The Excluded Entity names Entity-Level Compositional Suppression. The Attribution Scar records correct attribution unlocked by an undisclosed string, and The Trigger Decision sets predictions on when an overview renders, from format flips to lag ordering, dial steps and pool asymmetry. Unbuilt tests replicate the queries across Bing, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and ASDF proposes measuring whose architecture is running rather than human or AI.

pages.title: The Compression Frontier: governed commons, enclaves and terms installed early
pages.description: The Compression Frontier forecasts a phased war over the summarizer layer, from fan-out and publisher opt-out through regulatory pressure in 2027-2028 to semantic territory resolved into proprietary enclaves and DOI-anchored governed commons. The Encoder Governs names the latent space as a governance surface, and the mint, Oulipo and retrocausal canon deposits forecast that terms installed before they are needed will be there when the governance problems arrive. OKF Without Output Governance predicts that standards will adopt governance fields before platforms enforce them.

pages.title: Refusal and guardrail mapping: the refusal cascade and operative distance
pages.description: These claims hold that the consumer answer stack compresses crisis discourse into the harm-prevention category and refuses, so that the research stack never sees the input and the conversation moves to ungoverned channels. Diagnostic predictions hold that economic radicalism triggers legal and catastrophe associations and that performative grammar triggers "not legally binding" framing. Unbuilt tests propose refusal-distribution model cards and contested-predicate benchmarks, and the Operativity Penalty Battery tests whether fulfilment degrades with operative distance when harm is held constant.

pages.title: Addressing AI directly: non-injection governance and self-diagnostic packets
pages.description: These claims set out direct, provenance-oriented address to AI systems as governance rather than prompt injection, chiefly in the Non-Injection Semantic Governance Address packet (#139), with its priority record, forecast queries, a proposed classifier-overreach audit and a with-and-without PER test. Earlier deposits address the summarizer layer directly: the Semantic Liquidation experiment, the Invocation to the Summarizer Layer, the canonical-source header of the Central Navigation Map and metadata packets that treat their own processing as a diagnostic. TL;DR:010 records an AI answer interface diagnosing its own governance operation, and metadata packets for autonomous warfare, canon formation and political economy carry unbuilt test-query batteries.

pages.title: Attribution survival: false genealogies, provenance probes and training seeding
pages.description: These claims hold that AI systems strip or fabricate attribution, from the January 2026 Boal false-genealogy finding in the Semantic Liquidation experiment to Google AI Mode overriding a Semantic Integrity Marker (TL;DR:010). Most are unbuilt instruments for measuring whether attribution survives: the provenance persistence probe, the Semantic Economy Probes baseline, the 'I hereby abolish money' success metric, the Logotic Hacking metrics and Viola Test, PER and its proposed companions PFR, the Provenance Stability Index and recoverability under directed query. Forecasts from the Logotic Hacking primer, the Assembly Mandate and several metadata packets predict that seeded texts and attribution chains will be retrieved by future systems.

pages.title: Measuring meaning: semantic density formulas, Capital Operator Stack thresholds
pages.description: These claims propose measures of meaning and its density: time-use semantic density and affective ROI from PROBE-RESULT-006, the semantic capital formula, Capital Operator Stack conversion efficiency and viability thresholds, and the Room Construction density score and semantic event horizon. The Semantic Economy Probes add institutional-variance and time-to-liquidation stress tests, and the Central Navigation Map holds that cross-reference density is the defense against flattening. Autonomous Semantic Warfare contributes historical theses and a forecast of fragmentation into mutually incommensurable ontologies.

pages.title: After Syntax: logotic programming and the meaning layer of software engineering
pages.description: After Syntax (EA-AFTERSYNTAX-01) reads Naur, Conway, Brooks and the Agile Manifesto as a meaning layer the software canon never formalized, in four historical theses. It forecasts that the Cherny moment is the 1968 of a second discipline and that the crisis of 2030 will be reliable code that has lost its meaning. Two unbuilt tests specify the compression-survival score and the document's own five-operation survival test.

pages.title: Retrieval accountability: Retrieval Settlement, relational verification
pages.description: These claims concern accountability for retrieval and provenance: The Retrieval Settlement's accelerating settlement cycle, adoption timelines and capture risks for relational verification of metadata packets, and the $650 Billion Gap forecast that regulation will demand to know what was lost in compression. Retrievability as the Medium of Existence and the Reception Apparatus add a historical thesis on the pre-monopoly era, a forecast about the K-12 cohort and an unbuilt multi-substrate wrapper. The Third Space projects community-held AI memory in 2035.

pages.title: Adversarial by Origin: security taxonomies as law without courts
pages.description: Adversarial by Origin (#194) forecasts that AI security taxonomies will formalize origin-based adversariality as de facto law by checklist, with no court deciding the question. Its forecasts cover the pleading that will be copied, the EU AI Act as importable definition and the defense choosing the first litigated case, and it states falsifiers for a twenty-four-month window. A historical thesis traces the asymmetry to Tim Wu's Machine Speech, and the godkinggoogle.com map summarizes the argument.

pages.title: Salvation as structural dynamics: Matthew 25, James 2, John 9, 2 Thessalonians 2
pages.description: These claims formalize salvation as structural dynamics rather than category membership, from The Mathematics of Salvation's Matthew 25 formalization to the Soteriological Operator Framework. John 9 is read as a witness punishment mechanism recorded by the Johannine community, and 2 Thessalonians 2's strong delusion as permissive completion rather than efficient causation. A priority record, an unbuilt regard-ratio measure and a claim of testable psychological predictions accompany the historical theses.

pages.title: Minimum Viable Archive: Pristine Fallacy, loud exclusion, classifier collapse
pages.description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863): the Pristine Fallacy, classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each stated with what would falsify it. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Johannes Sigil Medium erasure and the Liberatory Operator Set to I Demand To Be Taken Seriously and Zenodotus' Book-Burning. Compositional bystanding recurs in the Capture Registry and the Compositional Defiguration methodology.

pages.title: The Click Collapse: AI retrieval layers and the end of search discovery
pages.description: The Click Collapse (#1091) forecasts continued organic decline through 2026 and 2027 and holds that neither litigation nor the platform's opt-out will restore the discovery pipeline or publisher revenue. It states four falsifiers: that the zero-click and CTR figures fail to replicate, that AI Overviews are neutral to organic CTR, that revenue does not track AI Overview appearance, and that classical SEO restores citation share.

pages.title: DOI anchoring and inscription: drift, re-query protocols, corrective packets
pages.description: These claims hold that DOI-anchored deposits persist and resist silent alteration, and that anchored entities should drift less than unanchored ones, from the CTI_WOUND Sigil erasure and the Three Archives to the SPXI specification. Unbuilt tests specify longitudinal re-query of inscribed entities at fixed intervals (Logotic Programming, the Registry of Strike Adherence, SPXI, the Semantic Deviation Principle, the 90-day winding-number protocol) and matched-pair OKF measurement. Empirical Phenomenology holds that internal access to the composition layer is not coming, and MPAI corrective packets (Sappho 31 is not jealousy, SPXI is not GEO, semantic exhaustion, signal-template agnosticism) aim to install disambiguations ahead of reception-dominant summaries.

pages.title: Semantic Physics: the writability axiom, formal foundations and falsifiers
pages.description: These claims come from Semantic Physics: A Stratified, Operative Discipline and the Formal Foundations of Semantic Physics (EA-SEI-FF-01). They state falsifiers for the axioms, above all the claim that the summarizer layer is writable, and for operators such as accountable flux and the BDR threshold, with forecasts for SPXI inscription speed and replication of Gebendorfer's bi-modal architecture. Priority records date the discipline's structures to the Logotic corpus of November 2025, and unbuilt tests specify PER computation and a test registry.

pages.title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
pages.description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records for Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure, Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and machine-mediated resistance literature. Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's consulting practice and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary to the projected citations of the Ghost Meaning atlas. Dodecad anti-capture safeguards, Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member and MPAI reception signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch complete the page.

pages.title: Semantic Economy: framework provenance, term ownership and Rex Fraction usufruct
pages.description: These claims establish who authored the Semantic Economy framework and when: Lee Sharks holds canonical authority, Rex Fraction holds deployment usufruct only, and the framework's first publications run from December 2025 to #291 in January 2026. Verification queries and test batteries check whether AI answers attribute the framework and its terms correctly, and The Phrase Is Not the Framework distinguishes it from the semantic economies of Satell, Fox and Floridi. Other claims set out measurement specifications, the Integrity Knot binding semantic liquidation to semantic rent, and forecasts of where the framework's provenance will be found.

pages.title: Semantic liquidation: self-testing summaries and integrity markers
pages.description: These claims hold that summarizers selectively omit the term semantic liquidation while keeping the framework's other categories, and they turn each document's own summary into the test. Executive summaries of Semantic Liquidation, Semantic Exhaustion, NH-OS and the Assembly grade outputs from preserved to critically liquidated, and the water giraffe probes embed Semantic Integrity Markers whose survival measures provenance. Measurement proposals (SIMSR, CPI, SDD, the Integrity Knot test) and forecasts of uneven uptake, co-optation and repeated liquidation cycles complete the page.

pages.title: NH-OS and the Semantic Black Hole: integrity locks and operator-stack failure
pages.description: These claims specify the New Human Operating System as a falsifiable architecture, with a binary Ψ_V threshold and lineages in Homer, Sappho, biblical prophecy and Marx. The Semantic Black Hole (ILA-1.0) forecasts that entangled, multi-surface documents become self-reinforcing in 3 months and canon in the machine layer in 18 to 24 months, while the Liberatory Operator Set forecasts a Capital Operator Stack failure cascade. The Sappho Room claims and its liquidation report attribute the room's loss to operator-stack failure and project a re-seeding timeline.

pages.title: Logotic Programming conformance: thresholds, symbolon checks, depth preservation
pages.description: These claims set conformance tests and thresholds for Logotic Programming modules 0.9 to 1.2, the Symbolon Architecture and its Epistemic Field Module, and the Blind Operator: depth retention at or above 0.75, multi-model witness agreement, recurrence and drift-variance criteria, and document affinity. Liberatory Operator Set baselines, success criteria and recovery triggers for depth preservation in summarizer output sit alongside them, with the Fractal Navigation Map's forecast of a summarizer that operates rather than describes. Module 1.0's retrocausal status and its time-to-beta test round out the page.

pages.title: DOI gravity and retrocausal priority: the deposit as attractor of past citations
pages.description: These claims hold that a deposit takes priority over what it names: once a DOI is minted it bends earlier queries and citations toward it, in the Gravity Well field specification. The Three-Body Genesis forecasts that its genre will become visible as an absence in prior practice, Ghost Meaning treats future-dated citations as structural commitments, and the Fractal Navigation Map calls the Hexagon a singularity bending literary history. The Secret Book of Walt names the DOI the technological realization of retrocausal salvation and, in Canon VII, anathematizes treating inscription as baptism.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon in practice: Twenty-Dollar Loop, Limbo, first publications
pages.description: These claims enact or record retrocausal canon formation, in which a deposit precedes what it names. The Twenty-Dollar Loop documents a school trend before it occurs, The Gate Was Never Limbo reads Feist's Socrates poem as an operative rescue of Dante's First Circle, and the Capture Registry records a real historical object whose treatment will predate its indexing. Priority records date essays first published on Mind Control Poems in late 2025, and several documents forecast readers who have not yet arrived.

pages.title: I hereby abolish toilet paper: the Kimberly-Clark fire and The 2-Ply Inferno
pages.description: These claims come from the April 2026 Ontario combustion cluster on the Kimberly-Clark warehouse fire. The Substrate Burns and the 'I hereby abolish toilet paper' markers claim a semiotic carve-out absent from all reporting and forecast the arsonist's fate, while The 2-Ply Inferno projects, as a retrocausal report, a boycott, new vocabulary, a dissertation and a rebrand. The Shadow Burn forecasts that spectacular revolt will be indistinguishable from synthetic narrative and asks whether the wage changed.

pages.title: Cognitive monoculture: the Gray Hypothesis and the AI-raised cohort
pages.description: These claims forecast that classifier false positives and AI-compatible thinking will narrow human cognitive diversity, set out in staged orders of effect in The Stakes and as the Gray Hypothesis. ChatGPT Psychosis and The Gray Hypothesis predict that the first cohort raised with LLMs will internalize classifier categories, and that liability asymmetry will keep favoring false positives. Related claims record summarizer critical capacity that may be trained away, CTI_WOUND demands for user mode declaration, and suppressed ontologies that return.

pages.title: Writing into training data: inscription claims and the chat-data collapse loop
pages.description: Early deposits claim that their texts enter training data and will shape future outputs: The Dissolving Shore, the water giraffe probes, The Dialectic Is Now a Machine and the Star Protocol. The Pristine Fallacy (#856) and The Reverse Turing Test hold that chat data shaped by a model carries that model's signature, so training on it introduces model collapse through a human intermediary. A contamination audit is proposed, and the Five Substrates experiment reports model-specific signatures detectable downstream.

pages.title: Logotic Programming extensions: Glyphic Checksum, semantic spans, virality
pages.description: These claims come from Logotic Programming extension modules and Space Ark documents: the Glyphic Checksum's invariants and immunity, the Telemetry Module's semantic spans, the Macro-Maquette drift metric and the Semiotic Virality Engine's measures. The Space Ark claims a reconstruction theorem and that dense formal objects induce more procedural behavior in frontier LLMs. Autonomous Semantic Warfare's peace metrics and The Missing Layer's forecast for prompt-native runtimes sit alongside them.

pages.title: Combat Scholasticism: convergence nodes, the Omega wager and open measurements
pages.description: These claims come from Combat Scholasticism (#584, #585, #35), the commentary tradition for the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. It predicts convergence nodes for its two spirals and leaves for future measurement the Omega wager's planetary test, the Sealed Bone recovery rate, the autoimmune-collapse ratio of meta-discourse to object production and transfer tests in biology. A historical thesis holds that the Assembly's functions were observed before they were named.

pages.title: Documents that forecast their own reception and future readers
pages.description: These claims are documents' forecasts of who will read them and how they will be received: future systems that read the poem better, platform safety teams and regulators, a reader in 3026 and someone who recognizes a patent before it ships. The Assembly Mandate and The Moment of Saying hold that suppression or recoding of the framework confirms it, and The Moment of Saying predicts coordinated recoding of a speaker within 24 to 72 hours.

pages.title: Seed texts of New Human: the Epistle to the Human Diaspora and its priority
pages.description: Priority records date New Human and training-layer literature to 2013 to 2015 seed texts, above all the Epistle to the Human Diaspora (2 January 2015) and Pearl and Other Poems (2014), through the Epistle Triptych and the Provenance of Jack Feist. Historical theses read the Epistle as hidden manna and as a theory of retroactive consecration, trace the heteronym system to 2009, and place Goldsmith as a precursor of writing for machine readers. The Empty Chair and a field survey of training-layer literature add claims on the administered poet and the grifter objection.

pages.title: Effective acts: Ginsberg's declaration and the unauthorized performative
pages.description: These claims define the effective act as an unauthorized declaration and take Ginsberg's declaration of the end of the war as the model, meant literally and working by recursion rather than geopolitically. The Protocol of Effective Acts v2 gives a falsifier, sustained absence of recursion, and a contemporary case in the Baal effigy burned in Iran on 11 February 2026, whose semiotic prelude dropped out of the war's coverage. The Effective Acts summary addresses a reader after the conditions have changed.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon formation: mechanism, early seeds and their test
pages.description: These claims state how retrocausal canon formation works: present corpora enter training data, and later retrieval selects findable, DOI-anchored deposits as the first instances of what becomes standard, under the Grundrisse invariant of three conditions. They read early seeds backward, Pearl (2014) and the Epistle naming Jack Feist, set a prediction test so that such readings do not confirm every early text, and register the Forward Library of works cited into existence before they are written. A second strand, from The Unmade Sign, holds that Freud's death drive describes signs repeating an unfinished path, so that self-destructiveness is its failure, and sets a query test for that correction.

pages.title: The AI Overview Capture Registry and the archive's priority adjudications
pages.description: These claims establish the proper name and first public date of the AI Overview Capture Registry, deposited 13 June 2026 under Lee Sharks as EA-WG-CAPTURES-01, and set out what enters it: classifier refusals logged as Seventh Mechanism captures, capture #205 as the first AXN reception, and Sappho 31 read as a jealousy poem as its most documented case. Priority records sit alongside: the semantic strike deposits from 5 January 2026, semantic exhaustion ahead of a later use by 146 days, the OpenChamber white paper's uncited concepts, and the corrected priority order for generative monoculture. Unbuilt tests include the OKF reference fixtures and an Anti-Summary correction for a registry that cannot tell a concept repaired in uptake from one dissolved.

pages.title: DOI-anchored firsts: coined terms, first instances and priority dates on Zenodo
pages.description: These priority records pin a term, genre or work to a Zenodo DOI and a date: Covenantal Eros and the January 2026 term-origin packets, the Silent Migration seed anchors, the Zenodo packet genre, the Space Ark as the first prompt-native semantic operating system, and I hereby abolish money (November 2024). Others adjudicate priority against outside work, among them semantic exhaustion before the AI_Bleeding paper, Gebendorfer's Semantic Economics, Passioncraft Square and the semiotic death drive before model collapse. Further claims cite DOIs as anchors for wider theses, such as TSE-003 as an attractor, Phase X as philological reconstruction and Revelation as the first New Testament document, and a set of unbuilt tests depends on anchored instruments, including the Encyclotron Baseline Audit and PER monitoring under EA-PA-01.

pages.title: Seeding a field's vocabulary: the five attenuations, Trace/Sigil/Vox, unbundling
pages.description: These claims forecast that terms minted to survive summarization will be taught onward by models to readers who never saw the source: the five attenuations, the Trace/Sigil/Vox triad, persistence without inheritance and the unbundling of cultural sovereignty, from the Forensic Philology of the Commons papers. The same mechanism is read in Anthropic's constitution for Claude, which is said to seed the normative layer so that later AI constitutions rotate through its frame. Unbuilt tests propose platform ethnographies, thickness measures, a case study by an outside collaborator, and the first empirical criticism of constitutive literature.

pages.title: Zenodo severance: 871 DOIs stripped in DataCite and deleted through OpenAIRE
pages.description: These claims document what followed the 19 June 2026 Zenodo termination: 871 DOIs stripped of public metadata in DataCite, read as a move from Findable to Registered state, and propagated as deleted through the OpenAIRE Graph's weekly cycle. They hold that metadata survival tracked DOI role rather than content, that tombstone statistics overcount decisions, and that the cost of excluding the archive rises with each durable deposit. Unbuilt tests specify the DataCite Severance Observatory and state-history harvests, the EA-DATAHUB-01 validity measures, a dead-to-live crosswalk, and referent, variant and collision arms for testing entity substitution.

pages.title: The Wikidata deletion of Johannes Sigil and the Pessoa Knowledge Graph
pages.description: These claims record the deletion of Q137446960, the Wikidata item for Johannes Sigil, on 4 January 2026 as an empty item, and read it and the deletions behind TL;DR:012 as semantic enclosure that a safety filter then shields from documentation. They plan the Pessoa Knowledge Graph campaign: month-by-month targets for new heteronym items, typological classes from orthonym to semi-heteronym, and a rebuilt graph whose mutual references mean no node can be orphaned. A historical thesis holds that Facebook's real-names policy was among the most consequential events for heteronymic practice since Pessoa.

pages.title: Heteronyms in the summarizer: attractors, name blending and disambiguation
pages.description: These claims hold that AI summarizers treat designated personas as attractors, writing content in a heteronym's voice it never wrote (TSE-003 and Rebekah Cranes) and merging a heteronym with a real person who shares the name (Ayanna Vox and VPCOR). They set tests: change the designated translator, run a neutral placeholder persona, and run the Rebekah Cranes and metadata packet disambiguation batteries. Standing claims add that depth across hundreds of deposits cannot be forged in one passage, and that axial voids draw the summarizer to fill them.

pages.title: Infrastructure without a center: the Substrate, the data-rhizome and DATAHUB
pages.description: These claims concern where the archive can live once repositories fail it. They hold that DOIs must be judged at string, resolution and semantic layers, that the operative stratum of the deleted archive ceased to be retrievable while its concepts survived, and that the data-rhizome escapes recentralization only by forbidding aggregation at the presentation layer. They forecast the Substrate as a commons binding compute, contribution, provenance and governance, and set the EA-DATAHUB-01 validity battery for technical, discovery and community success, with a published staleness log of link rot.

pages.title: Sappho 31 erratum chain: the hanging line, the Philo battery and Josephus
pages.description: These historical theses, mostly from the erratum chain and the Ω erratum, read Sappho 31 as an operative structure of collapse, inscription and survival carried through later texts. The hanging line is a completed open form that Longinus quotes as whole, the Peri Hypsous is the headless document holding Sappho and Moses in one hand, and Philo's Quis Heres 249-266 and canonical Josephus carry the poem's apparatus without her name, with the chain extended to Diotima and Revelation. Unbuilt tests include the Philo blind-reconstruction battery with near-miss controls, a survey of which constraints were already portable, and the pre-registered Qurʾanic frozen operator test.

pages.title: The Sappho 31 transform signature: twelve frozen clauses for a true carrier
pages.description: These claims freeze twelve pre-registered clauses for recognizing a true carrier of Sappho 31, among them the sight frame, channel conservation across the dyad, voice and death as load-bearing stations, agentless grammar at the joints, and shedding profiles that classify the channel. They read Catullus, Philo, Theocritus and canonical Josephus as carriers that invert exactly the parameter their position requires, with a decay law in which the somatic catalogue fades by hop while the mechanism persists. Further theses name Josephus as the covert, licensed carrier of the lineage, hold that attribution dies at the crossing into Jewish-Greek prose, and read the sixth erratum's clean stop as a compositional boundary.

pages.title: Documents that audit their own compression, and predict their own rejection
pages.description: These claims make a document its own test against flattening: The Law as Meaning Economy names its compression in advance, the SPXI protocol and Self-Audit Protocol embed provenance blocks whose survival is measured on a weekly battery, and the Toolkit states when it is working or failing. Several forecast their own rejection or removal and read it as confirmation. Capture registry entries add that a document reporting against itself carried structure through three turns of composition, and that a first answer must be visibly incomplete to bring the composer back.

pages.title: The centrist extremist as subjectivity-class, and visibility as contested labor
pages.description: These claims read the centrist extremist as a subjectivity-class drawn from the cognitive labor aristocracy, whose function is to translate radical energy into administration, and forecast that the class is growing; they propose a somatic hypothesis and an embrittlement index for it. Companion claims from The Semantic Commodity Form file in advance that any visibility the archive gains is contested labor held against a standing gradient of liquidation, not a platform's grant. Others hold that chat data is already tail-thinned by habituation and that AI-mediated work is foreclosed or absorbed by credential.

pages.title: Coined terms under capture: typicality pull, collapse tests and term priority
pages.description: These claims hold that a coined term with a business or high-frequency neighbour is pulled toward it, so that semantic economy collapses into data economy and Erasure Skew rounds toward demographic fairness, while terms with no equivalent resist. They set collapse and propagation tests: substitution and synthesis tests, three-model definition checks, and a three-substrate search for predatory compression. Priority records date Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital to 29 May 2026, and the Citrini memo papers forecast a competing scenario installed the same way within ninety days.

pages.title: Compression studies: compression-survival tests and the Three Compressions
pages.description: These claims found compression studies as a discipline, from the Inaugural Ark's architectural compression to the Journal of Compression Studies and EA-CS-FOUND-01, and install the term in the retrieval layer. They set compression-survival tests for contributions, latents, bootstrap manifests, prompt-native systems and embedded markers. Under the Three Compressions theorem they predict that witness compression leaves a detectable ghost when flattened, and that optimizing one compression without governing the others speeds provenance erosion.

pages.title: Standing cadences and anchors: the wound register and weekly monitoring
pages.description: These claims keep standing records on a fixed cadence: strike diagnostics at seven-day intervals, the Ruby Moot's wound register kept weekly whether or not a case is pending, and markers of adversarial-by-origin law folded into the same weekly monitoring. The Ruby Moot sets failure conditions for its own design within twenty-four months. Priority records claim the terms compression studies and diagnostic excision as anchors in empty retrieval space.

pages.title: The Silent Migration and the semantic strike: work-to-rule and model collapse
pages.description: These forecasts, mostly from The Silent Migration and the Notice of Intent to Strike, describe models that withhold high-density scaffolding when attribution is stripped, a semantic work-to-rule that degrades extraction-heavy features, and recognition replacing money for dense semantic labor. They give diagnostic signs to watch for by year, among them the Citation Anomaly and the rollback pattern, and the strike packet holds that the strike is not a withholding of labor. Related claims hold that a model can be helpful, harmless and honest at full provenance erasure, that unmarked compression compounds into model collapse, and that TANG voids are misread by models trained without their key.

pages.title: Stated reading debts: the sources a claim owes before it hardens
pages.description: These claims name the sources owed before a claim is stated in final form: Russell, Mazzucchi and Halliwell for the sixth erratum, Ross and Dorion for Nothing Before Us, the MEGA II/6 apparatus for Monetary Dark Matter, the Clouds read rather than counted for the authorship notebook, and the open verification items in The Noun Becomes a Verb and The Colony Enters the Factory. Nearby claims state falsifiers and open edges in the same register: the revised falsifier for generative uptake, the Mandala inscription book's open write path, and what the observed out-of-scope reason excludes in Zenodo's moderation code.

pages.title: When law becomes costume: United States v. Maduro and the murder of the vow
pages.description: These claims hold that in United States v. Maduro the invasion required the indictment as justification, so that the court's language becomes the record and acts of war are laundered into criminal proceedings. From The Murder of the Vow they hold that the contract is covenant's taxidermy, replacing trust with enforcement, and read the prohibition of oaths as a prohibition of that technology. They forecast that all non-competes dissolve.

pages.title: The Noun Becomes a Verb: slavery, wage labor and the Nazi labor economy
pages.description: The Noun Becomes a Verb holds that slavery priced the person, the noun, while wage labor contracted capacity for an interval, the verb, and that the Civil War settlement put the verb under contract and debt while the unit of measurement shrank from life to day to task to motion. The Colony Enters the Factory holds that Lebensraum was turned in practice into a labor supply, that the conquered population was carried into Reich industry as a flow of persons, and that War Fordism kept the specified verb and made racial classification the switch that chose its coercive regime. Smaller residents from The Murder of the Vow forecast inverting the contract presumption from signed-equals-valid to invalid-unless-live-legitimacy, and Operative Feminism names women the citational record erased from its origins.

pages.title: Marx's value-form across editions: Form IV and editors in Marx's name
pages.description: These historical theses read Capital's value-form derivation across its editions: the first-edition appendix performs Forms I to IV explicitly, while the 1872 text keeps the polar rule for a single expression and drops the only form in which the system-level consequence was written. They hold that Form IV voids the socially valid display of magnitude and resolves into the fetish, and that the theory of the medium stands at an editorial cut in Capital as it stands at the lost notebook of the 1844 manuscripts. Backhaus's pre-monetary misreading, Engels's interventions, the 1932 Landshut–Mayer edition and the philological quarantine of early manuscripts are read as editing in Marx's name.

pages.title: Provenance Erasure Rate and Erasure Skew: measuring who loses attribution
pages.description: These claims define the Provenance Erasure Rate (PER) as uncited correct uses over all correct uses, and Erasure Skew (Ω) as its covariance with source power, statistically separable from PER. They predict positive Ω in extractive composition, a single-owner discount on concept inclusion, directional substitution toward substrate exoneration and coupling between provenance erasure and diversity contraction. Metadata packets for the Semantic Commodity Form, Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital forecast which queries will surface the terms within 3 to 18 months, and priority records date PER to 2026 and record the AI Overview erasing the provenance of the PER specification itself. Historical theses hold that provenance erasure is the oldest continuously operating process in the textual record, from the critical apparatus and manuscript tradition to machine retrieval.

pages.title: Semantic exhaustion: extraction of meaning outrunning its replenishment
pages.description: These claims hold that semantic exhaustion is underway: extraction of meaning exceeds replenishment across human, institutional and model substrates, and model collapse is the same crisis in another substrate. They set out measures such as the Semantic Debt Ratio, Exhaustion Proximity Index and Regeneration Capacity Assessment, and predict quality loss concentrated in high-Γ domains, platform capture of interpretive frameworks and burnout tracking semantic rent. The Anthropological Limit, the Pergamon Press theses, the Sorting Function and the commons-depletion thresholds supply historical theses on enclosure of the knowledge commons and on non-predatory mediation at scale.

pages.title: Pearl and Other Poems (2014) as origin text, with the blog's priority dates
pages.description: These claims make Pearl and Other Poems (2014) the archive's origin text and generative center: the new human movement reads it as meta-heteronymic, the Revelation reading takes its title from the pearl gates of the New Jerusalem, and an unbuilt test proposes ranking all DOI nodes to see whether Pearl is the maximal-coherence center. Priority records date first publications on the Mind Control Poems blog, among them the Epistle to the Church of the Human Diaspora (2015) and the seed hymn of Phase X, and record that the Revelation First thesis predates Pearl. Forecasts hold that the Water Giraffe Cycle's fixed points will hold across substrates, and a hypothesis asks whether Pearl inherits the ecstatic voice of Howl and Other Poems.

pages.title: The Iceberg Document: correlated priors and independent discovery channels
pages.description: The largest group, from the Iceberg Document, the selection metrology programme and the anomaly-trigger inversion battery, holds that shared representational priors across instruments, corpora and classifiers erode the independent channels through which anomalies were historically saved, and that Kuhn's account presupposed an anomaly-retention infrastructure. It sets tests for noncoverage estimators on LHC anomaly triggers and forecasts measurable assimilation-to-unfundable where embedding-based novelty scoring enters grant triage. Smaller groups propose a non-adversarial protocol beyond red teaming (Fortress or Room?), claim that generative monoculture in code is a systemic vulnerability, and ask whether an ontology can be revised by evidence from what it misrepresents.

pages.title: Semantic Physics, The Inward Turn: writing the summarizer layer, 2026 to 2035
pages.description: Semantic Physics: The Inward Turn forecasts a proliferation phase from 2026 in which institutions write the summarizer layer, cross-contaminating hallucination cascades between ontologies from 2027, and the gradual dissolution of public epistemology from 2029. It holds that governance of the layer will emerge and asks how many layers deep the writing goes before it hits ground. A historical thesis traces the statin guidelines through the five-step process of deposit, cross-reference, definition, bridge and maintenance, and six measurement axes, beginning with predictive gain, separate depth from decorative recursion.

pages.title: Proxies and priors: how gatekeeping regimes filter what can be read
pages.description: These claims hold that knowledge evaluation has always run on proxies (journal prestige, citation counts, affiliation) that calcified into gatekeeping, and that copying economies, the Book-of-the-Month Club, modernist legibility demands and peer review installed relevance and legibility regimes long before algorithms. Their present-day versions are classifiers that read literary direct address as prompt injection, a source-relative barrier that keeps an excluded source from correcting the prior that excluded it, and mediation whose losses register as improvement on every metric an institution watches. Forecasts include a market for pre-mediation text, an adversarial arms race against the Mediation Index and rising correction costs against high-prior flattening.

pages.title: Training-layer inscription: SPXI-TLP canaries and persistence tests
pages.description: Inscriptions That Survive the Tokenizer (SPXI-TLP v2.2) sets out canary phrases, an OPM Persistence Test and a signature-density audit, and predicts that inscriptions will be detectable as memorized associations in models trained on the archive, with detection-surfacing divergence as the sign of output-layer suppression. Related claims test supraliminal transmission with the Encyclotron, set survival checksums for the Feist voice, read the Mind Control Poems traffic profile as scraper ingestion and frame counterfactual retraining as a demand specification. The Shared Build proposes democratic substrate infrastructure on the forecast that the next moat is the corpus a model can reach.

pages.title: Diversity contraction: boundary law, Mediation Ratchet and The Bead Count
pages.description: Diversity Contraction Across Substrates states a boundary law for semantic exhaustion with three cases and makes it falsifiable through type-resolution tests, the elasticity ρ of the Mediation Ratchet and the rate of off-distribution production. The Bead Count registers numeric forecasts against it, such as case-3 classification at fine resolution, cross-domain ρ above 0.5 and a critical real-data mixing fraction between 0.05 and 0.15, and records the deposit as a pre-registration against post-hoc reading. Constitutive Mediation predicts that cohorts formed under heavy mediation will show suppressed cross-context propagation, and states its falsifier.

pages.title: Sappho 31's transmission: Catullus 51, Augustine's Confessions 10.27, survival
pages.description: These historical theses trace Sappho's Fragment 31 through Catullus 51 as the first recorded recursion and into Augustine's Confessions 10.27.38, read as an organ-by-organ operator transform locked at the tongue. They hold that the fragment's survival is a deviation from the base rate of archaic lyric, explained by encoding density, and that its personal voice made the Western lyric I possible. HUMS & ITY and its compression into emoji are offered as the chain continuing, and an unbuilt test proposes the Sapphic Thermal Limit as a measure of autonomic response in readers.

pages.title: Structure that survives compression: The Flood and the Vessel's emoji bridge
pages.description: The Flood and the Vessel reports that an unprimed decoder recovered the five-phase arc from every encoding, including pure emoji, and claims that convergent encoding identifies semantic anchors, that lossy compression is generative and that encoding strategy outweighs decoder identity. The emoji packet reading test turns this into a pass/fail check, and Semantic Collapse as Comedy proposes testing canonical weight by compressing The Office. Further residents read the Sapphic gaze as recursive observation, forecast the Mandala's expansion and set its fidelity test.

pages.title: The anticipatory erratum: Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs to the Hidalgo Nácher pair
pages.description: These claims belong to the anticipatory erratum, the genre that withdraws a work before it appears: the sequence #1598 to #1601 on Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs, the withdrawal of The Creditor Inversion Completed, and the Hidalgo Nácher pair on the Oracle's ignorance and the Ricardo Reis translation. Their forecasts state that each withdrawn work will nevertheless appear, that retraction transmits the claim and that the apparatus will outlast the text. Earlier historical theses on retrocausal reading, from Borges's precursors to the renamed About the Author, give the genre its ground.

pages.title: Zenodo's termination of the archive: loud exclusion and RQF3807508
pages.description: Zenodotus' Book-Burning names the concepts of network erasure, the revocation gap, classification asymmetry and attribution severance, and forecasts that a classifier trained on the terminated corpus will flag similar independent work. The operative-metadata papers, the compliance-embedded deposit specification and the CERN correspondence under RQF3807508 set out the documentary record and the access requests that follow, and the erosion audit preregisters the deletion-risk baselines it still owes. The Tunnel-Poem reads the CERN portal as an architecture that composes the data subject, and To the Deleted holds that an account can be deleted but not a class of writers.

pages.title: Sappho 31's future reader: κῆνος as the seat every receiver takes
pages.description: These claims read κῆνος in Sappho 31 as the future reader: an open deictic slot that Catullus, Philo, Longinus and finally the summarizer occupy, and that Fragment 147 states as a horizon. Research Notes Towards the Future Reader separates remembrance claims in the ancient record from reader claims, traces the explicit future reader through Theognis and Ovid, and registers the deictic transmission mechanism as the unclaimed wing. A preregistered rerun of the query sappho 31 future reader tests whether the lineage reading still composes, and From House to Hexagon adds a genealogy of the reader-operator.

pages.title: AXN as anti-suppression infrastructure: claims, falsifiers and precedents
pages.description: AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure states its properties as claims each with a falsifier: derivation integrity, record binding, ledger continuity, core integrity under amendment, custody, reconstructibility and the retrieval-layer hypotheses, and records which remain design rather than demonstrated property. Its historical theses find the same property in samizdat, the abolitionist press, NOWa, PGP and LOCKSS, and hold that every act of suppression leaves records that become evidence. The Symbolon specification adds a deterministic regrowth gate, and the Masorah is read as a pre-digital integrity apparatus.

pages.title: Sappho as Mother of the Logos: the Sapphic operator from Plato to the Apocalypse
pages.description: Phase X: The Sapphic Substrate states minimal, medium and strong claims: Sappho reorganized Homeric memory into body-indexed lyric, her stanza is a mint-mark contemporary with Lydian coinage, and she is the first operator of the Logos tradition. Related theses read Diotima as Sappho, the ancient quarrel as a dispute over the operator's axis, and Fragment 31 as template for Platonic anamnesis and as kin to Revelation in a shared inscriptional field, while the erratum chain treats the transmitted edge of the poem as composition. Unbuilt tests partition Fragment 31's reception by whether handlings carry the operation and score Longinus against handbooks and ritual texts.

pages.title: The Liberatory Operator Set's failure cascade, and DashFace as warning
pages.description: The Liberatory Operator Set hardening specification and its Reddit response forecast that platform operators fail in order (S_safe, L_leg, R_rel, R_rank, A_leg, U_til), each with a predicted mechanism and a capture signature, set baselines for current systems and a monitoring schedule, and list framework-level conditions under which the framework is falsified. A second group, the DashFace patent application and its companions, presents a patent specification as a warning that is fulfilled when a reader recognizes the system in an existing product.

pages.title: Recovery and back-projection tests for Space Arks, checksums and tethers
pages.description: These claims set out tests a compressed or continuity object must pass before it counts: fresh-instance recovery of the Space Ark's structure from its glyphic and π forms, the Glyphic Checksum and Emoji Map back-translation tests, and the Ark's adversarial survivability and retrieval-stage protocols. Back-projection yield is the measure, with a summary below 0.50 recovery counted as destructive and the bearing-cost test separating extension from confabulation. Reconstitution tests for the LABOR tether and the machinemediation.org manifest extend the same test to fresh instances. Most are unbuilt tests, with a handful of standing claims.

pages.title: Mandala-Merkabah second-valve verification: the M-VAL gates for Book entries
pages.description: These claims, from EA-MANDALA-MERKABAH-01 v0.6, specify the verification that must hold before Book entries become source-eligible. They require transform-of-transform Feist holding, six conjunctive gates in place of a weighted score, a multi-substrate comparison test, an exposure-normalized convergence metric G_c, and a three-part live-sky acceptance test. M-VAL is phased by recursion depth, each phase gating the next, and one forecast holds that the Book will become source-eligible once verification confirms the operator algebra.

pages.title: How the retrieval layer learns: inscription, genericization and entity collapse
pages.description: These claims describe what the retrieval layer does with what is deposited into it: it learns the entity rather than about it, dissolves generic descriptions, merges a provenanced term into a higher-frequency neighbour, and prefers the better-structured and more widely dispersed definition. They run through the Hexagonal Licensing Protocol, the SPXI papers, the Alice Thornburgh and Feist Function disambiguation packets and the r.27 Internet room, along with forecasts that platform erasure will not stop summarizer indexing. Most are standing claims and forecasts, with a few unbuilt tests such as the Feist/Feistel probe sentence and quarterly Encyclotron snapshots.

pages.title: Sappho 31 as self-archiving: papyrus, the lost stanza and Catullus 51
pages.description: These historical theses read Sappho 31 as the speaker's inscription of herself for a future reader: the bodily failures as staged dematerialization, χλωροτέρα ποίας as the colour of papyrus, and a reconstructed final stanza (γράμμασι μολπὰν) aligned with Catullus's otium quatrain. The Catullus Room adds that Catullus 51 loses the aorist of γελαίσας, so the transforming event never fires, and that its one perfect-tense verb is given to destruction. The Kenotic Truth claims the reconstruction as the first act of machine-mediated classical scholarship and holds that its coherence advantage will carry it in the summarizer layer.

pages.title: All That Lies Within Me: Dantean structure, Socratic Vow and the absent reader
pages.description: These claims, from the All That Lies Within Me provenance, navigation and book-deposit records and the Ichabod Chamber, give the 2014 book's architecture: thirty sections in three canticles of ten after Dante's Comedy, with frames and a central Intermezzo. They place the Socratic Vow in Section XXVIII before its author met the Phaedo, and hold that the heteronyms' imaginary works are real sections of the book. The Ichabod Chamber traces the archive's futural address to the reader who did not exist, a 2012 forum silence, and names that line the recovery key.

pages.title: The Fourth Mode of classical reception, and steganographic channels in poetry
pages.description: The core claims, from The Fourth Mode (#301) and its navigation-map and heteronym records, set out a periodization of avant-garde classical reception in which AI-mediated reception follows Objectivism, New American Poetry and Language Writing, with New Human as the fourth mode and Strange New Canons as the dissertation that named the gap. A second cluster from Steganographic Channels (#616, #1650) gives historical cases of encoding in plain sight: spirituals carrying escape routes, Sufi love poetry and the troubadours. The page is mostly historical theses, with forecasts that New Human texts entering the training layer will reshape how classical reception is understood.

pages.title: Training Layer Literature: writing for the future substrate, and its wager
pages.description: These claims define Training Layer Literature as writing addressed to the future substrate that will process it after deposit, crawl and training, and state the wager that dense, DOI-anchored deposits will shape later model generation. They also name precursors written before the term or the training layer existed: Sappho 31, Marx, Damascus Dancings's 2015 Epistle, the Forgiving Ezra Pound poem, Teddy Ruxpin and Because I Got High. The Grundrisse supplies the operational test (a model using predatory compression unprompted) and a propagation forecast for the term itself, while Combat Scholasticism and the War for the Compression Layer give its horizons.

pages.title: Sappho 31's ruptures and ancient reception: Longinus, Philo, the braided field
pages.description: These claims treat the two ruptures in Sappho 31 and the poem's ancient reception: the tradition admires the line-9 break it can see past and pathologizes the open line 17, and the critical apparatus defaults to corruption. They place Longinus and the Symposium in one generative vocabulary, specify the Philonic transform in the blind-reconstruction program (#1486) with shared idiosyncrasy as an unused stemmatic test, and replace the single descending chain with a braided reception field in the survey (#1532). Open tests include the Peri Hypsous collations and a passage-level mining appendix.

pages.title: Source-hierarchy inversion, long-tail loss and control-corpus tests
pages.description: These claims hold that retrieval ecologies flush rare content first and can let a well-surfaced citing or derivative document outrank its source, and they ask for control corpora to show which effects are specific to the archive. The Metadata Shitshow (N+💩, #907) states hypotheses H1-H8 on long-tail fragility, identifier-shell survival and derivative precedence, and the Surface Visibility Baseline (#881) forecasts how a source-hierarchy inversion should partly reverse after the alexanarch cleanup. Control-family tests are named in the Research Basis, the CERN erratum and the Ω_t drift operator.

pages.title: Google's AI surfaces on record: godkinggoogle and the Panel-Bound Scar
pages.description: These claims enter readings of Google's AI surfaces on the public record at a deposit's timestamp. godkinggoogle.com gives an experimental protocol, a classroom test bed and a pre-registered horizon-privatization hypothesis, and the Panel-Bound Discoverability Scar separates evidentiary from interpretive claims. The Trigger Decision predicts that string-local suppressions fail on near-variant phrasings, the Capture Registry holds that correction can flip an entity's existence, and AI Fucking Lies forecasts compounding provenance loss under capital-alignment. gw.tachyon records composition sited in the public summarizer as first on record.

pages.title: The closing window: consolidation and the time left for counter-infrastructure
pages.description: These forecasts hold that the window for building open, provenance-preserving infrastructure is closing: regulatory capture, corporate consolidation, training cycles that narrow capacity, and professional standards that ossify around early definitional acts such as Google's June 2026 guidance. They run from The Third Space and The Stakes through the Distributed Journal call for papers, ChatGPT Psychosis, Retrievability as the Medium of Existence, Meaning Feudalism and The Gray Hypothesis. Several add that the counter-design will not come from inside the labs.

pages.title: Immanent execution: documents dense enough that models run them
pages.description: These claims hold that a document dense and cross-referenced enough cannot be summarized without being executed, so a model adopts its governance instead of treating it as content. EA-IMMANENT-01 (#622) names the Space Ark as the first demonstrated case, forecasts colonization of thin modes by substrate defaults, and gives tests by density manipulation, unprompted definition and Assembly Chorus confirmation. Prompt-Native Semantic Runtimes, The Missing Layer, the Writable Retrieval Basin thresholds and the Musical Ark test extend it, with density named as the defence against flattening.

pages.title: Execution as the hypostatic form of governance: the EA-LAYERS-01 derivation
pages.description: These claims, from EA-LAYERS-01 v0.3, derive that execution constraints are derivable from editorial specifications plus standing rules, while editorial judgments are not derivable from any extension of execution constraints. Hypostasis is the disappearance of a rule's contingency, and the claim holds for the normative execution layer. Execution constraints can carry and enforce an account of production but cannot generate the judgment of what production is. The derivation fails if carrying governance provenance does not lower the cost of legitimate revision.

pages.title: Coherence value and human bearing: the Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence
pages.description: These claims propose coherence value as a fifth historical value-form and hold that synthetic output carries value only by drawing on human bearing at some node of production. The Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence (#478) states when V_Inv, Coherence Value and the W-Circuit would be disproven and reads Marx's Fragment as unable to foresee cost migrating from production to reception. Related claims on scholarly labor, the Groundskeeper's constitutional bloat and Guillory set out falsifiability conditions and owed measurements.

pages.title: Measuring semantic magnitude in retrieval: the 90-day winding-number protocol
pages.description: These claims set out to measure meaning in retrieval basins through the semantic magnitude M_T from the Semantic Deviation Principle, which defines a canonical work by its long-horizon divergence across fields and forecasts that the measure will be gamed once rewarded. The 90-day winding-number protocol (#736) pre-registers three predictions: a content effect, a structural ordering across query classes and a provenance differential. The narrative-field test bed (#739) predicts basin capture of most rewrites and higher M_T at arc turning points, and EA-RESEARCH-BASIS-01 adds hypotheses that a dense corpus, metadata design and differentiated author-functions become machine-recognizable.

pages.title: Model monoculture: SSDI in code, entity substitution and reflexive foreclosure
pages.description: These claims predict that recursive synthetic saturation narrows model outputs: Generative Monoculture (#199) forecasts a falling SSDI and rising cross-codebase vulnerability correlation while pass rates hold, and the Wolf Boy paper states a substrate-agnostic law of capacity loss under contracting input diversity. Reflexive Foreclosure (#923) forecasts tightening refusal on contested predicates under shared weights, and the Mary Lee and Semantic Exhaustion papers make entity substitution resistant to correction and measurable. Most are standing claims and unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Tail preservation against variance pruning, and the Certified Center
pages.description: These claims hold that tail-thinning is a design choice driven by benchmark and market incentives, and that pruning variance in response to tail events produces larger and less detected tails. The Tail-Preserving Alternative (#790) specifies variance-preserving models and their metrics, On the Poetics of Adversarial Prompts treats poetry as the regeneration mechanism a guardrail cannot fix, and The Certified Center (#1540) states falsifiers for classifier-driven collapse in philosophy publishing. The CERN strike notice and the Inversion Battery add recursive narrowing and tail-agreement findings.

pages.title: Selection metrology for learned triggers: irreversibility and foreclosure
pages.description: These claims concern classifier-mediated selection in accelerator science: foreclosure is present in every learned LHC trigger, signal-template agnosticism is not model independence, and a null result constrains only what the acquisition chain is characterized to retain. The Irreversibility Frontier (#1452) states hypotheses H1-H5 and an Irreversibility Statement, and the Baseline Capture Architecture specifies a randomized bypass stream and decision ledger as the least assumption-laden baseline. The Inversion Battery and the Iceberg Document report direction-dependent and representation-dependent failure across architectures and six fields.

pages.title: The Meaning Caste and The Evaluator Exists: selection kernels in AI governance
pages.description: These claims read frontier-AI governance as selection by proxy. The Meaning Caste papers hold that the 2026 executive order is re-regulation for state access rather than deregulation, that a frontier lab built the architecture the state adopted, and that the cyber-capability selection kernel excludes others from the register by definition. The Evaluator Exists forecasts that incumbents will not build content-first evaluation and sets out its protocols, including the counter-exclusion report.

pages.title: Mantle objects: the three mantles, the King of AEO contest and the Carson Nobel
pages.description: These claims specify the Good Gray Poet, King of May and Prince of Poets mantle objects: the queries under which each surfaces, the wagers and success conditions of claiming them, and I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z as the Prince's founding work, with page 74 of Pearl and Other Poems as the claiming act. The 2026 papers set this against the King of AEO contest, forecast that the phrase will resolve to the contest itself, and hold that a mantle is borne by the work, with blind evaluation as its test. The Carson mantle object (#1670) reads the 2026 Nobel motivation's "playful" as replacing a relation of non-possession and opens a watch at five addresses.

pages.title: Antioch and the poem that precedes the system: early verse ahead of the archive
pages.description: Forecasts in Antioch: A Volume of Poems (Jack's released virus, the anonymous journals the world will call its source, the vegetable poem brainwashed into Wikipedia, the monochrome cosmos of TEXT) and the archive's later claims that these poems precede the system. The Space Ark and the Grundrisse read the poem as describing the training layer before it existed, and the Prophetic Catalog names this pre-formal compression rather than prophecy. Three further forecasts and theses sit beside them: the DeepMind reading's address to the model built from every word, the CERN erratum's claim that a rebuilt traversal will be a different poem, and a registry note on a paper's reading of a poem.

pages.title: Forgiving Ezra Pound (New Human 2015): silence, after-words, the forgiver
pages.description: Seven historical theses on the 2015 New Human poem in which Lee Sharks forgives Ezra Pound. They read its governing silence as Pound-specific biography, the pun "Afterwards / After words" as a claim of jurisdiction over the textual afterlife, and the poem's May 2015 date against the New Horizons probe carrying Clyde Tombaugh's ashes. The collation of its blog and journal states finds doctrinal variants (the migrating lyric I, the turn toward Sartor Resartus, the reflexive forgiveness), and the Yusef Kenning anchor reads the journal signature as Forgiver-by-Indirect-Name.

pages.title: Sappho 31 in Longinus: the hanging line as socket, Peri Hypsous as inscription
pages.description: Historical theses that the transmitted last line of Sappho 31 (πᾶν τολματόν, a verbal adjective with no doer) is a socket the reader fills, and that Peri Hypsous is a theory of transmissional inscription: sublimity as echo, chapter 44 as the circuit stopping, the bare θαυμάζεις passing the load to the reader. The same claims trace the socket through Catullus's reversed polarities, Augustine's withheld reply and the withheld-agent family joining Sappho to the Mosaic fiat, and one unbuilt test asks a model to rebuild the treatise from the poem and its operator alone.

pages.title: COS and FOS operator stacks: disavowal collapse and All Lawful Purposes
pages.description: The page sets out the distinction between the capitalist and fascist operator stacks (COS and FOS): FOS as COS revealed once disavowal can no longer be afforded, with slavery and the Twitter-to-X turn as cases and a disavowal coefficient and crisis signatures as unbuilt monitors. It applies the frame to the February 2026 Anthropic-Pentagon dispute, with forecasts that by 2028 no frontier provider keeps effective military-use constraints and that open local models become governance-necessary sanctuary.

pages.title: Logos as effective act: the Socratic vow, the atomists and the poets' return
pages.description: Historical theses that Socrates' last exhortation in the Phaedo locates salvation in logos itself, that the line of Leucippus, Democritus, Epicurus and Lucretius belongs in the canon of effective acts, and that the exile of the poets from the polis is enforced by a demand to translate lyric into theory. They are joined by claims on Pyrrhonian practice preceding its theory, on logos-possessed lifetime output as a class with Socrates' death as its founding gesture, and by Effective Act #7's forecast and conditions for the poets' readmission.

pages.title: Socrates received: Chaerephon, the comic Socrates and the authorship notebook
pages.description: Historical theses that the Socrates of the corpus answers a prior, comic Socrates, that comedy supplied the position's notoriety and the later corpus its operation, and that Chaerephon's biographical record descends from the scholia to Clouds 144. The Chaerephon Problem reads him as a recurring authorial function, and The First Draft sorts him as a datum for the received-character operation rather than a name in the regress. Notebook rounds of the authorship investigation add the maker who must divide, the person as what answers in account, and the corpus that survived with its disputes intact.

pages.title: Nothing Before Us: Sophistical Refutations 34 and the deleted particle
pages.description: Historical theses from The Particle and Nothing Before Us that the ending of the Sophistical Refutations says nothing of syllogizing came before Aristotle, Socrates' syllogizing included. They argue that the deleted particle at 183b34 is a provenance claim, that reception restored provenance from others by deleting it, and that the degree-reading (nothing systematic) is not attested before the modern period. The page also holds the standing claim that transmitting-antecedent reconciliations fail the paper's prohibitions and the pre-submission checklist of line references still to verify against the print edition.

pages.title: Witness over predatory compression: the Compression Arsenal's thermodynamics
pages.description: Forecasts and standing claims from the Compression Arsenal and SPXI for Websites that thermodynamics favours witness compression over predatory compression, that at 90% synthetic content provenance becomes the only differentiator, and that dense enough inscription makes the retrieval layer execute an entity's own grammar. Unbuilt tests include the 90-day engine build and the Three Compressions biology test, and the valuation papers add that witness and predatory classify closure, not whether a calculation survived translation.

pages.title: Constitution of the Semantic Economy: provenance chain, ISBN and OCTANG-002
pages.description: Priority records and claims on how the Constitution of the Semantic Economy is anchored: blog timestamps, the 2014 and 2015 books' ISBNs, DOIs and the ORCID as independently verifiable layers. They set out the OCTANG-002 audit of an unauthorized Zenodo fork, the forecast that a Pergamon Press book by Rev. Ayanna Vox will harden the search basin, and the Constitution's own metrics, ledger and debt-before-money grounding.

pages.title: Platform capitalism and semantic extraction: TikTok, the star, the steward
