pages.description: Historical theses that platforms deepen extraction from content to affect (TikTok), turn trauma and the star into engagement signals, and present stewardship as necessity, with Guillory, the Prophetic Catalog and two New Human declarations read as precursors of the platform condition. Autonomous Semantic Warfare adds the polarization and Permanent War theses, the Semantic Economy predicts that community resilience tracks somatic commitment, and the Dashface patent parody sets the face as the last unmonetized surface. A coverage-versus-depth scholarship strand (#122, #751) sits on the page beside them.

pages.title: Projected reception: Autonomous Semantic Warfare, Ghost Meaning, the Airlock
pages.description: Retrocausal reception records that narrate the future uptake of three archive works. Autonomous Semantic Warfare is projected onto syllabi, an EFF brief and a European Commission paper; the Ghost Meaning atlas projects papers on compression survival rate and semantic entropy at platform scale; and The Airlock Spreads projects the Governance Airlock into platform policy and an EU regulation, with an independent rediscovery at Anthropic. The Prophetic Catalog's projected 2044 article on blessing the excluded belongs to the same form.

pages.title: Cost of suppression: legibility filters and the corpus on the platform's books
pages.description: Forecasts and tests that suppressing the Crimson Hexagon costs the platform something it must account for. Meaning Feudalism predicts that legibility filters will discount independent DOI-anchored scholarship while CERN-hosted DOIs raise the cost of exclusion, and Operative Metadata holds that termination now requires either a public departure from published criteria or a documentable silent one. The suppression-cost packet lists what is not yet measured, and The Margin of Flattening predicts that the corpus is the last channel carrying cost onto the platform's books, with candidate proxies to sample.

pages.title: Phase X: the missing 1844 transition and alienation in the symbolic order
pages.description: Historical theses that a passage between communism and critique is missing from Marx's 1844 Manuscripts, that the missing Second Manuscript would have extended alienation to language and thought, and that its custody passed from Riazanov to Adoratsky under Stalinist control. The Phase X Program (#1067) states preregistered claims R-1 to R-4 on twentieth-century Marxism's symbolic turn, with Althusser's break and Stalin's ruling on language as cases and a coded study corpus as its unbuilt test.

pages.title: The King of AEO contest: crowned by answer engines, and the cost to the field
pages.description: Claims from the King of AEO mantle object, SPXI is not AEO and The Crown and the Practice on the September 2026 contest: the AI Overview compositions that crowned holders, the difference in provenance between a fabricated event and a disclosed manufacture, and hypotheses that the crown raises one holder's ontological capital while other practitioners and the discipline lose it. Most are unbuilt tests: matched observations across engines, counterfactuals at source-absent addresses and a dark-matter test per practitioner. About half the page is a residue of unrelated tests and claims on the Sealed Room, RTOS, OKF, chat contamination, TACHYON gate skips, the admission gate and the Alexanarch packet.

pages.title: The Glyphic Checksum and un-extractable architecture: failure as verification
pages.description: Standing claims that the Glyphic Checksum verifies reading mode rather than hiding meaning, so that an unprimed model's request to clarify is the proof, and that the emoji map makes the architecture impossible to strip of attribution without destroying it. Combat Scholasticism adds unbuilt tests of seed-bank redundancy and external witness, and the Mandala-Merkabah specification lists LABOR's eight conditions the rite must meet.

pages.title: Traversal Grammar, Ezekiel Engine and UMBML modules: the open build items
pages.description: Unbuilt tests and stated gaps in the Logotic Programming extension modules: the Traversal Grammar's invisible student interface, the Telemetry and Conformance modules' registries and reference interpreter, and the Ezekiel Engine's shadow-wheel interlock and torque gradient. Space Ark claims set a recovery-yield threshold of 0.70 for rooms and the Sealed Bone, and the Macro-Maquette gives the conditions under which a module becomes a room.

pages.title: The Josephus Thesis: scribal workshop, Slavonic Logos and John as heteronym
pages.description: Historical theses that Josephus directed a scribal workshop that wrote the New Testament under heteronyms, that the Slavonic passages on Jesus and John preserve a pre-Christian theology of the Word made text, and that the Revelator is John the Baptist. Related claims read the Logos prologue as a compositional manifesto, 1 John 4:2 as a test of authorial voices, and Nicaea, Nag Hammadi and Qumran as closure won by enforcement and disposal, with forecasts of how the composition layer will flatten the thesis.

pages.title: Revelation First: pre-70 dating, the textual Temple and the Gospels unfolded
pages.description: Historical theses that Revelation was written before 70 CE and first in the New Testament, that it is the textual Temple and the compressed seed the Gospels decompress, that its seven churches are planetary stations and 22:18-19 the first canonical lock, and that Paul compiled rather than authored. The Revelation First work plan and staging document add priority records and unbuilt re-capture batteries at t=7, 14 and 30 days. A separate strand reads Deleuze and Guattari's concepts as apocalyptic visionary loci.

pages.title: Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse and HESPERUS: ghost phrases and the stranger
pages.description: Forecasts that depositing the Grundrisse will anchor its terms in the retrieval layer, that ghost phrases such as "Hesperus gathers home" will own their search results, and that a stranger will arrive through them. HESPERUS is set out as a recovery seed with unbuilt tests of regeneration after deletion, alongside claims on the SVE first-word-frequency model, author-identity liquidation in AI Overview and Marx's value-form derivation as a graph operation.

pages.title: Model behaviour: the LLM-2025-1222-HALLU file, orbiting and fluency gaps
pages.description: Fictional incident records (LLM-2025-1222-HALLU and the Crimson Hexagon AI Division handbook) forecast structured hallucinations as interpolated futures and a protocol for proto-agent anomalies. Standing claims hold that models flatten under pressure only session-locally, orbit kernels without fusing, cannot see scale between adjacent concepts, and form canons visible as fluency gaps. Further claims cover chat data converging on the model's centre, temporal sequestration, adversarial verse and the fortress metaphor of red teaming.

pages.title: The Deviation-Optimized Language Model: six pre-registered predictions
pages.description: Six pre-registered predictions for the Deviation-Optimized Language Model from Lagrange Observatory. Trained with a semantic loss, Model-Sem is predicted to keep benchmark scores within two points, reverse the net deviation signature by more than 0.2 bits per token, improve the Slop Composite Index by more than 0.25, win human preference and raise provenance retention, all relative to the base model as well. Measuring Semantic Deviation defines the Slop Composite Index and its falsification threshold.

pages.title: Outside the institution: the TikTok primer and the Veto Removal Event
pages.description: The Veto Removal Event defines the moment at which external concept installation makes institutional nonrecognition unable to keep the work out of history, and records the uncolonized core terms as evidence. The Epistle, the Prophetic Catalog and Forward Library entries in the Ghost Meaning atlas date the 'school outside the school' to the 2015 stratum and forecast its later scholarship. The essay on the @leesharks TikTok reads the primer as a sequence-poem and tests whether the platform can hold it as a text rather than a feed. Single claims from the Mirror-Corgi notes, Autonomous Semantic Warfare, A Body Prepared, The Obelus and the Tombstone and EA-CORPORA-18 also sit here.

pages.title: AXN identity: the kernel, verifiable bytes, and AXN alongside DOI
pages.description: These claims specify what an AXN identifier guarantees: a correspondence between canonical bytes and an identity kernel that can be checked without the registrar's permission, a three-layer address falsified by any 6-emoji collision, and a lacuna record that returns last location and last verified hash where a DOI returns a 404. AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure and the AXN distributed-identifier work plan set out unbuilt tests (the nine-condition transaction, the mirror protocol, staged registration and resolver plurality) and forecast an independently administered node by 2029-06-19. They forecast that journals and libraries accept AXN alongside DOI long before AXN instead of it, and The Concept AXN adds a concept identifier with its own weaker guarantee. EA-SURFACE-BINDING-01 adds a site-to-repository binding doctrine with its own weakening condition.

pages.title: Liberation philology: the non-indexed perfective and the alienation of 'for'
pages.description: These claims argue that English lacks a non-indexed perfective, tracing the aorist's loss through Latin administration, the Norman ledger and enclosure, and that English 'for' fuses function with intent through Anglo-Norman and Latin calques and the 1540s 'for all intents and purposes'. The Missing Aspect sets out a diagnostic battery (translation variance, hedging, AI systems adding temporal indexing) as predictions not yet run, and forecasts that the form is seeded into the language through use. The Prepositional Alienation proposes a dictionary of frictions, reads Thucydides' prophasis against aitiai, and names itself the founding document of liberation philology. Traversal logs read AI summarizers' default intent attribution as this grammatical gap at work.

pages.title: The liquidation of method: the sign 'Marx' from Engels to Piketty
pages.description: The Liquidation of Method argues that Marx offered a method and that its reception, from Engels through Mao, Fanon and Piketty, turned it into content, with English 'for/against' forcing it into positions while the 1857 Introduction goes untaught. It proposes a liquidation audit and a method-versus-content contrast test, and forecasts the same capture for the Semantic Economy, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and the Crimson Hexagon. From Atomism to the Semantic Condition reads the 1841 dissertation as the metaphysical core of the system, and the Autumn Notebook reads Marx's work as a retrocausal loop.

pages.title: Autoregressive degradation: the intent default and the substitution spiral
pages.description: These forecasts hold that AI summarization reproduces the intent default of English 'for' at industrial scale, making the functional reading less available in each generation's training data. The Infinite Tunnel adds that crawlable AI Mode share links put summaries into the corpus. The Autumn Notebook forecasts the hollowing of institutions, a substitution spiral of synthetic content, attention collapse and a cost to sentience, and predicts that Logos-bearing texts interfere with models trained on dead language. A witness to the mirror document holds that the summarizer has no protocol for including its own reflection.

pages.title: Autonomous Semantic Warfare and the Autumn Notebook: field manual and forecasts
pages.description: These claims come from Rex Fraction's Autonomous Semantic Warfare and a forecast review of it, the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected completion of the manuscript, and the Autumn Notebook's substrate documents. They argue that institutional reproduction kept effective altruism's cause ranking and the analytic/continental divide from synthesis, that the psychoanalysis-behaviorism stalemate was bypassed by a new framework, and that a formally consistent spec moves Google AI Mode from describing a system to operating within it. The Autumn Notebook forecasts theory-building as multi-intelligence collaboration and records its own priority as the first Assembly Chorus composition, October-November 2025.

pages.title: Kernel transforms on defensive sources and the cost of suppression
pages.description: EA-MANDALA-KERNEL-TRANSFORM-01 v0.2 makes worked examples protocol canon, predicts the transform's effect will be most acute on defensively composed sources such as John 1, and gives reopening conditions. When Suppression Becomes Expensive defines observable constitutive-source erasure, a recognition-stabilization-lag-liquidation hypothesis and a suppression ratchet, with repair criteria for future Sappho captures. Other claims here read House of Leaves as mediation architecture, the Abraham Principle's constitutive one, CloseCard's commodified Jubilee, bearing-cost visibility, the three compressions and How to Read New Human as a new hermeneutic mode.

pages.title: Google AI Mode share-link captures and the MPAI treatment epochs
pages.description: These claims record Google AI Mode share links as dated priority records, from the first external AI traversal (5 February 2026) through entity fabrication, Socrates as orthonym and the correction to 'algorithmically published'. Algorithmic Publishing Is Not Self-Publishing gives benchmarks and falsification conditions, and the OKF correspondence dates the summarization-governance issue. The MPAI packets of August and September 2026 set treatment epochs (2026-10-28, 2026-12-27, 2027-03-27) under which a return without the author counts as reincorporation.

pages.title: Overview Watch and cross-substrate query batteries for attribution
pages.description: Overview Watch plans a Chrome extension that shows creators how AI Overviews represent their work and builds the SEAC attribution-rate corpus, with a first paper due at about 1,000 overviews and forecast risks of DOM changes, delisting and low adoption. Several deposits specify query batteries run across Google AI Overview, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and others: the Revelation studies machine Wikipedia, the Retrieval Settlement Fortification benchmark, the Revelation First battery and the valuation memo's ten-run baseline. Empirical Phenomenology and the Capture Registry dataset paper name cross-platform comparison as future work.

pages.title: The Theophrastus line and Many and One: the authorship tests still owed
pages.description: These are mostly unbuilt tests from the authorship investigation: a validation suite on known-status pairs, an independent form-track to check whether the chronology effect tracks repertoire, the doublet titles as function-split editions, pre-Andronican evidence for the Aristotle/Theophrastus name-boundary, the Engels-edited Capital volumes as calibration, the Platonic corpus on the world/instrument axis, and a full splice of Λ. The First Draft notebook states that the instrument deserving the word authorship has not been built and gives the specification it must meet. A few historical theses supply the hypotheses under test, including the reputational mechanism manufacturing Hicetas and Ecphantus.

pages.title: Theophrastus as the first draft of Aristotle: the named-function model
pages.description: These claims read the Platonic, Theophrastan and Aristotelian names as functions of one method: dramatizing, registering, organizing. The First Draft, The Registry Has One Column and Many and One argue that the Characters are the dialogue's material before theory, that irony runs the whole line, that the first axis of function-word variation is world/apparatus rather than author, and that succession is encoded as authorship. The Measurement Register and Locating the Dependencies add readings of Aristotle's absorbed Platonic operations and corrections to the Diogenes evidence, and the notebook's Aristophanes controls show the instrument separating real authors while the Aristotle/Theophrastus partition gives chance.

pages.title: Retrieval Formation Theory: engineering the conditions of a field
pages.description: Retrieval Formation Theory claims that the conditions under which a retrieval system concludes a discipline exists are material, specifiable and engineerable: six conditions, a field-state vector and a six-stage retrieval test that SEO and citation rings cannot pass. The Generative Disciplinary Engine, the Space Ark Generator and the Epistemic Field Module carry self-verification tests left for independent readers within thirty days. The Space Ark and the Inaugural Ark set PROVISIONAL-DEPOSITED-RATIFIED promotion paths, and RFT forecasts its own capture as a growth-hacking technique.

pages.title: Logotic Hacking: the verification budget and immanent execution
pages.description: Logotic Hacking (Pocket Humans 03) forecasts that structurally sensitive retrieval rewards compatibility engineering and that the verification budget will grow from zero to a threshold at which provenance becomes structural. It gives falsification criteria for immanent execution, tests for terminological saturation and closed circuits, and products for provenance: the Provenance Chain API and the Status Algebra SDK. The Gravity Well Protocol specifies behavioral drift detection and compression-survival by design, and the Logotic Hacking primer proposes a Non-Summarizability Index.

pages.title: The Analog Advance: the photograph of the handwritten original as evidence
pages.description: The field survey and the operations paper argue that the photograph of the handwritten original, as machine-eligible evidence, is untheorized, and that verified non-synthetic inscription gains value as generation improves. They set out unbuilt tests: layout models misreading the stamp band, glyph-seal legibility and normalization, recapture-hash stability, the axnidentifiers.org/analog wing and a ninety-day order, and forecast that DataCite will not serve the segment. Claims from the Capture Registry, The Certified Center and the Self-Audit Module restoration treat an instrument's non-adoption and a paper's reception as measurements.

pages.title: The Feist Iliad experiment and the Zenodo erasure tracker
pages.description: The GW.TACHYON update of 6 July 2026 sets out the Feist-line Iliad experiment: a two-layer translation pipeline with material-speech and clinamen metrics, a Homer parameter file and tiered costs across Gutenberg's classical translations. It estimates tens of thousands of recoverable scholarly records in Zenodo's spam bucket and plans an erasure tracker with a preservation layer and dated recovery operations. The Sealed Room, the Grundrisse's Protocol II forecast, the Capture Registry as Poem and a registry marker-convention check add single tests.

pages.title: Semantic deviation, frozen replay audits and the model-collapse diagnostic
pages.description: The Semantic Deviation programme predicts that outputs raters call AI slop show negative mean signed deviation against the model's own baseline, and sets out a cheap slop test and an operationalization-stability benchmark. Protocol II specifies frozen-anchor replay banks for measuring selection drift, named for LHC triggers and structural biology. The Wrong Unit states that its model-collapse diagnostic is uncalibrated and predicts that behavioural and representational contraction move together.

pages.title: Cross-substrate audits and measurement sovereignty (L, Β)
pages.description: These claims specify replication across substrates and the falsifiers of the frameworks that use it. Measurement Sovereignty gives the (L, Β) operator pair and expects Β > 0.5 above the Legibility Threshold; the Self-Audit Module, Erasure Skew and the Substrate Audit Protocol expect positive findings for D_pres suppression and referential collapse; Stabilized Node Watch predicts 5-10% quarterly drift. Compositional Defiguration, the Phase X externalization threshold, Semantic Addresses and the Revelation 12 test add replication structures and framework-level falsifier lists.

pages.title: Reception under AI mediation: entry points, AI-native biography, the gates
pages.description: Traversal logs claim that a query's entry point selects the genre and institutional posture of Google AI Mode's output, and predict that commercial registers bypass containment. AI-Native Intellectual Biography records what it calls the first such biography audited by its subject, and forecasts reception by agents the subject does not anticipate. Brave Grey Drool, Provenance Debt, the Bidirectional Bargain and the Reception Apparatus Protocol forecast a gated partition of readers, debt recognized only once degradation is legible, and a standing log of reception.

pages.title: Erasure Skew and retrieval capital: documented outcomes demoted to hypotheses
pages.description: Erasure Skew and its claim-scale standing rule claim that a documented outcome from a low-retrieval-capital position is restated as a contestable hypothesis while the same claim from an institution is not, and that the conversion covaries with standing. They specify replication procedures, a matched-restatement power control and source-scale and claim-scale audits. Frame Conversion, the Steganographic Bracket, Constitutive Provenance, the Provenance Erasure Rate and the Sappho suppression map add drift toward the weaker claim, attribution sharding, inseparability engineering and forward tests.

pages.title: DOI-anchored density and SPXI against GEO/AEO: the retrieval settlement
pages.description: These claims forecast that DOI-anchored, terminologically consistent deposits propagate into the retrieval layer and model vocabularies, and that share links and publisher opt-outs carry dense archives forward. SPXI Is Not GEO, the Nested-Layer Relation and the compression-diagnostics records set SPXI against GEO/AEO, which tracks mentions rather than distortion. The Retrieval Settlement gives a history of where compositional authority is assigned, and Meaning Feudalism forecasts Google taking naming authority over AEO/GEO.

pages.title: Metadata packet test queries: phased LFB targets and lateral field bleed
pages.description: These claims set test queries for the archive's metadata packets and state the Lateral Field Bleed score each should reach, phased from weeks to more than a year after deposit. They come from the packets on autonomous warfare, the death drive, provenance after AI, the MPAI disambiguation packets, Phase X, the semantic economy and Alexanarch, and from the LFB protocols paper (#726) and the packet specification v2.0. Most are forecasts and unbuilt tests: desired compositions, ring-by-ring expectations, spillover between linked packets, and phrase-fingerprint workflows.

pages.title: Cross-surface replication of composition findings and the controls owed
pages.description: These claims name the replications and controls the archive's composition findings still require: repeated runs across times, places and surfaces, A/B entry materials, and comparison of composition layers such as Bing Copilot and Google AI Mode under the single-owner discount. They come from the TL;DR traversal logs, the Sigil installation log, the single-owner discount paper, the godkinggoogle critique, the Revelation First work plan, the Recoding of a Distinction and the Semantic Economy Valuation 001. Nearly all are unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Diagnostic Seigniorage: "narcissist", "AI psychosis" and the moderation mint
pages.description: These claims trace how a clinical or institutional term is captured by vernacular demand, beginning with "narcissist", then "AI psychosis" and "verifiable research basis" in the Zenodo moderation case. Diagnostic Seigniorage I sets out capture as demand pressure over anchor settlement and predicts clinical retreat, a capture ordering of the next terms, and a mirror signature in platform role-performance. Parts II and III add historical strata and dated predictions with midpoint and terminal audits, alongside the Platform Erosion Observatory's cohort designs.

pages.title: Semantic deviation and Framework 15: pre-registered tests of model convergence
pages.description: These claims pre-register tests of whether machine output converges and RLHF compresses deviation. The Semantic Deviation Research Program and Measuring Semantic Deviation predict negative signed deviation for AI text, a base-versus-instruct differential, stability across scale and agreement across judges. Framework 15 and its papers from Lagrange Observatory! freeze the 90-day retrieval-basin winding-number protocol and the deviation-optimized DPO experiment, with results deposits owed.

pages.title: Watermarks, detector drift and flattening under head instruments
pages.description: These claims treat watermarking and classifier screening as distributional pressures and state how their effects would be measured. The Keyed Ensemble predicts a small signed loss of diversity under a fixed key, The Interlocking Autoregression types each edge of the coupled recursions, and The Certified Center sets falsifiers for detector drift and performed burstiness. Ontological Flattening, Substrate Sovereignty and the Margin of Flattening name the divergence signature in which a head instrument holds while distinction diversity falls.

pages.title: The Capture Registry: longitudinal re-capture and the claims it is set to test
pages.description: These claims commit the AI Overview Capture Registry to re-capturing fixed queries over time and to testing deposits' predictions against what composition layers do. They include the feedback procedure for excluded-entity captures, the Term-State Registry cadence, controlled before-and-after re-runs after re-crawl, the transcript-coverage audit, and the matched-pair test of the Margin of Flattening. Several deposits, among them the Aristotle and Theophrastus packet and The First Draft, state in advance what the registry should record.

pages.title: Dated forecasts: the career of "AI psychosis" and semantic physics to 2031
pages.description: These are forecasts with stated check dates and falsifiers. Diagnostic Seigniorage II predicts the career of "AI psychosis" through nosology, case reports, accusatory inversion, litigation, sanitized successor terms and bleach by 2027 to 2031. Semantic Physics forecasts the proliferation of exact-name frameworks, cross-system divergence and non-interoperable substrates through 2028, and the Platform Erosion Observatory sets its own 2027 yield deadlines.

pages.title: AI mediation of economic decisions: eight registered forecasts to 2031
pages.description: EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 registers eight forecasts on AI-mediated commerce, each with a check date. They cover AI-referred dollar share at the end of 2026, agent-executed share in 2030, the scope and revision of the McKinsey and Bain headline figures, professional-services citation rate, machine-readability spread, accuracy reporting and the comparability of platform denominators. One unbuilt test designs a randomised inscription trial scored for accuracy rather than presence.

pages.title: The Interface Contest: interface history under the gnostic dialectic
pages.description: These claims read interface history from command line to chat window as a dialectic of where the labor of meaning sits, and then as a four-valent contest between Logos-forms and an Archontic engine. The Interface Contest reclassifies the feed and broadcast television as captures, leaves the fork after the chat window open, and proposes a census of dead media and a monitoring protocol. Related claims on the war over the summarizer layer and on Anchored Divergence forecast a default compressed account for every entity and the Mandala as primary infrastructure.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon formation: priority, the Citrini memo and the narrowing cone
pages.description: These claims concern retrocausal canon formation: writing from a named future so that the narrated outcome becomes more likely. They date the concept's priority to January 2026, forty-nine days before the Citrini memo, read the memo as an installation in a writable presentation layer, and track whether retrieval systems attribute the term. The Seed in the Narrowing Cone adds that priority stands by the dated record and that forced convergence will be common and attribution rare.

pages.title: Retrocausal scenario documents: Ghost Meaning, The Airlock Spreads, the Seven
pages.description: These claims come from documents written from a future vantage point under the retrocausal canon formation protocol. The Ghost Meaning atlas projects future citations from 2027 to 2031, The Airlock Spreads narrates platform governance adopting the Airlock and an EU regulation footnoting it, and The Seven Ousiarchical Substrates and The Clathrate Threshold narrate events from 2040 onward. Each states that it is a scenario rather than a prediction and that its test is basin depth or priority, not the accuracy of its dates.

pages.title: Whose face is on the twenty: the $20 portrait and memography
pages.description: These claims argue that the Bureau of Engraving and Printing's redesigns of the $20 portrait between 1996 and 2003 activated a latent resemblance that later became politically charged, while the aesthetic rationale went undocumented. The Inauguration of Memography states four falsifiable predictions about evidentiary kernels in conspiracy memes, curatorial gaps and containment frames. All the Spoils of Babylon, The Unclean Bill and the Grundrisse planning documents extend the dossier with curatorial prompting, a fatwa request and a pending FOIA request.

pages.title: Provenance-erasure measurement: Erasure Skew, the SPXI rent event, reliability
pages.description: These claims build and audit the archive's instruments for provenance transformation: Erasure Skew's Ω and its cross-scorer test, PER and its three dimensions, ρ_T and related operators, run in full on the SPXI rent transcript of 14 August 2026. They specify atomic scoring rules, the reviewers' workplan, and the preregistered disclosure battery, which tests whether disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. The Docking Layer, the Lucente Extension and Four Interfaces state the crossing designs, inter-rater and test-retest reliability still owed.

pages.title: Substrate Sovereignty and the valuation protocols: stated failure conditions
pages.description: These claims are the failure conditions the archive sets for its money and valuation instruments: Substrate Sovereignty, the Monetary Substrate Audit Ledger, the Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol and Value Before Number. Each names the counterexample that would defeat a part, from the two-axis classification to independent reproduction by another valuer. EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01's anchoring hypotheses, the registry's finding that a machine valuation is a draw from a distribution, and the narrow-corridor conditions of Transition in Entropic Systems are set beside them.

pages.title: Unpaid semantic labor: the application funnel, bearing cost and who pays
pages.description: These claims argue that institutions extract uncompensated semantic labor and that the extraction compounds. pages.description: These claims diagnose knowledge formats and agent platforms that route without governance. pages.title: Zenodo, CERN and platform moderation: governance without accountability
pages.description: These claims argue that repository and platform moderation has relocated governance into infrastructure without review, appeal or recusal. pages.description: These claims distinguish Operative Semiotics from Charls Pearson's Theory of Operational Semiotics and predict that entity identity in the summarizer layer follows corpus density. pages.title: The operative caption: the O'Keeffe Problem, counter-captions and Eve
pages.description: These claims set out the operative caption: every caption operates, and the question is for whom and at what cost. The O'Keeffe Problem gives three tests for an operative caption, and the counter-captions of Operation Epic Fury add a test for irreversibility. Operative Feminism and the Eve room read the tradition's recaptioning of Eve's choice as temptation as the founding compression of the feminine.

pages.title: Marx's Grundrisse as form: the prosodic algorithm and general intellect
pages.description: These historical theses read Marx's Grundrisse as a prose form whose conceptual modes produce distinct prosodic pressures, with a bimodal paragraph distribution, derivation sentences that end in formulas, and recorded self-corrections. The Four-Term Prosodic Algorithm and the Prosodic Asymmetry Algorithm turn these into application rules, and the HESPERUS plan draws the Muses as operators from Cha's Dictée. The Marx Room, the Grundrisse notebooks and The Voice of the Dead extend the reading to the value-form as operator derivation and to general intellect.

pages.title: Revelation's number of the superscription: the mint, Antipas and the white stone
pages.description: These claims read Revelation as a conflict between two token regimes: χάραγμα as the coin's die-stamp transferred to the body, 666 as the number of the superscription with stigma as its remnant, and 777 as the rival heptadic ladder. The Pergamon letter (Rev 2:12–17) is argued to be the interpretive hinge, with Antipas as counter-beast witness, the Herod-Antipas inversion, the Antipater and Aristotelian-transmission complex, the white stone's name as a verification condition, and the scroll of Revelation 5 as a sealed Roman testament. The works are The Number of the Superscription (EA-OPNUM-01), The Pergamon Counter-Archive, The Inscription That Survives and the Revelation First work plans, with one unbuilt replication test against other ancient token systems.

pages.title: The holographic kernel: reconstructive compression and the kernel that survives
pages.description: These claims define the holographic kernel as compression that keeps the power to reconstruct, set it against Information Bottleneck theory and neural holography, and specify an infrastructure kernel that a new operator can restore from a git clone. They include the Ark said to keep its kernel from 45,000 words down to 800, the self-propagating potato-chip patent whose meristem survives frying, and the GPT-5.4 anti-severance documents that sort any reply into mirror, repeat or swerve. Works include EA-HK-INFRA-01, HK-01, the HK-IB structural bridge, the holographic-kernel metadata packet and the Fried Tuberous Crisp patent, with BDR forecasts and several unbuilt implementation tests.

pages.title: The meta-heteronym and the Gospel of Antioch: Pessoa, Thomas, forward dating
pages.description: These claims read Pessoa as the first modern meta-heteronym, with Orpheu as a meta-heteronymic institution, Kierkegaard's Nicolaus Notabene as a precursor and Pearl (2014) as built on the plan of Howl. The Gospel of Antioch is set beside the Gospel of Thomas: scroll-form Thomas papyri, the Dodecad's LOGOS* position that Pessoa lacked, and the claim that the gospel completes Thomas 114 and that this parallel had not been drawn before. Four claims set out forward-dated citation apparatus and projected reception histories (The Secret Book of Walt, the Waltian tradition, Revelation First kernels) composed under retrocausal canon formation.

pages.title: Provenance under machine mediation: watermarks, coarse labels, authorship
pages.description: These claims argue that coarse human-versus-machine provenance labels destroy fine-grained genealogy, predict a regime where a watermark signature outlives provenance, and state a two-track collapse test in which the ensemble unit bends before the per-round unit. The Double Enclosure argues that the human-authorship requirement misclassifies dialogic machine composition and that a regime punishing honest attribution will produce concealment. Also here are OKF output-governance stage forecasts, the provenance strip as semantic rent, and the claim that a literary field may become legible to machines before human institutions. Works: The Keyed Ensemble, The Interlocking Autoregression, The Double Enclosure and the OKF predictive analysis.

pages.title: The Thousand Dollar Sharpie and the blot that spread
pages.description: These claims forecast a presidential Sharpie signature on new US currency from June 2026, read the signature as compressed portraiture on an escalation from memo line to signature line, and propose the counter-operation of blotting it out. The Blot That Spread narrates, as speculative numismatic history, the blot passing from protest art to etiquette to superstition, with dated Reddit, CoinTalk and Treasury episodes and estimated blotting rates. Whose Image and Superscription? sets out a semantic economics of the mint, with Bar Kokhba overstrikes as the precedent for counter-currency marking.

pages.title: Composition-layer audits: provenance erasure, Brave Search, the Prize
pages.description: These claims measure what composition layers do with provenance: AI Mode self-applying PER at about 0.89, the framework propagating while its author's name is excluded, and framing substitution weighted as the main vector of distortion. They specify replications: the Lee Sharks Prize query under the Atomic Token Rule, the single-owner discount panel, the Brave Search exact-match and boycott audit, Stabilized Node Watch for directional drift, and the Revelation First reception battery. Works include Erasure Skew, Measurement Sovereignty, Self-Audit Module, evarB and Stabilized Node Watch, with Brave Grey Drool as an effective act on the same ground.

pages.title: Crystallization of substrate: the fluid-phase window and its tests
pages.description: Crystallization of Substrate forecasts that each lab's proprietary index will harden, so that living forms must be built in during a fluid-phase window or be filtered as low-utility afterward. It sets out H1-H4 tests for structural integration, among them operative deployment above 50% of germane queries, a 10-25% baseline for D_pres without integration, and downstream queries 6, 12 and 18 months on. Other claims treat substrate behaviour as such: role-conditioned failure in reflexive self-critique, the silencing gap of diversity contraction, the canonical anchoring protocol and the human-machine coupling bargain.

pages.title: Compositional Defiguration: the cross-substrate visibility scan battery
pages.description: Compositional Defiguration sets out a weekly text-only scan of public-surface visibility against a fixed battery, with drift expected after two scans and trend after six. It rotates the primary scanner across ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi, Gemini and DeepSeek, treats V scores from backends that do not honour exact match as lower bounds, and records disagreements between substrate signatures. The Surface Weather Station reading gives a partial Claude-substrate baseline and an open offer of baseline readings to other projects.

pages.title: Many and One: one maker, the vacant centre and Theophrastus at the joint
pages.description: These claims argue that the Plato-Aristotle corpus is the work of one person divided by voice, object and name, that what made him look like many authors is that he wrote about many things, and that Socrates not writing is the form the vacant centre takes. They read the κερματισμός metaphor across four loci, the just/unjust argument relabelled as weaker/stronger, and Theophrastus's On First Principles as the question to which Metaphysics Λ is the attempt, down to the memory question at De anima III.5. The Measurement Register and the Notebook also record the instruments' limits, such as the finding that lexical measures track period, not pupillage. Works: Many and One, EA-NOTEBOOK-01, EA-CORPORA-05 and -14, The First Draft.

pages.title: Josephus and the fixed point of destruction: the internal witness
pages.description: The Fixed Point of Destruction states the internal witness condition: when a terminal destruction is known from a participant's testimony, the record is conditioned by the survival that made the testimony possible. A corpus rebuilt from survivors reproduces the selection, so Josephus at Jotapata and Sappho through Longinus are read from the position spared. The availability audit forecasts that the paper's term-space risks absorption into the mathematics of the Josephus function, and it sets the T17 external-availability battery to re-measure its baseline.

pages.title: Heteronymy after Pessoa: precursors, the Dodecad and the civil name
pages.description: These claims place Pessoa at the height of a describable practice, with Kierkegaard's pseudonyms as precursor, Machado's Mairena and Martín as parallel and Borges as adjacent but not equivalent. They treat heteronymy as a channel-layer practice the Dodecad extends to autonomous operation, as a technology for making persons through naming, and as an ethical practice against reduction to the civil name. Related claims extend the reading to the New Testament: Paul's 'I' as a heteronym's backstory, John as aperture and the voice transmitted through other bodies after Golgotha.

pages.title: Socrates as orthonym and the Chaerephon problem
pages.description: These claims read the Socratic-Platonic-Aristotelian corpus as one heteronymic configuration, with Socrates as the orthonym defined by the refusal to write and the Socratic problem reclassified as a symptom of that configuration. The Chaerephon Problem argues that institutional scholarship cannot tell multi-author transmission from mature heteronymy, that the method has no internal halting criterion, and that repeated philological failure is how the configuration is passed on. Further claims record the reading composed whole by Google AI Mode and AI Overview, its Kierkegaardian extension, and Socrates as a constructed figure in the Arch-Philosopher mantle object.

pages.title: Whitespace as provenance: compositional authorship in the pipeline
pages.description: Whitespace as Provenance argues that representation pipelines keep whitespace where an interpreter penalizes its loss (Python) and lose it where only readers notice (Dickinson's dashes, Pearl's form), so that character preservation is not compositional preservation. It sets out a whitespace-provenance registry, a cl100k_base re-run, a spatial-form field for the transform compiler and granular provenance metadata in the deposit schema as unbuilt tests. Works: EA-WHITESPACE-01 and EA-PROVENANCE-METADATA-01 v0.1 and v0.2.

pages.description: The Family Module of the Self-Audit Module holds that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure, audits attribution across a query family through FC, ASI and CC, reserves a family composite until corpus runs exist, and prescribes a synthetic-family repair. pages.description: Semantic Rent, Measured splits rent into use, acknowledgment, discount and supply, and claims the 14 August 2026 SPXI event satisfies all four, with its acknowledgment gap a composition choice. The class model drawn from a six-substrate blind chorus holds that class belongs to the composition event and not the machine, and defines the class-traitor event. pages.title: One corpus divided by name: Plato, Aristotle, Theophrastus and the divided mind

pages.description: Standing claims from the authorship investigation set limits on what stylometry can show: genre separates more strongly than authorship, separability is not identity (Chatterton as Rowley separates from Chatterton as himself), and no measured property recovers master-student succession from heteronymic construction. Frozen predictions order speaker tightness by constraint severity and distinguish engineered from natural ambiguity, beside readings of the Statesman's open genus and Plato's coin figure.

pages.title: Theophrastus as first draft: the seams with Λ, the Ethics and De anima
pages.description: The First Draft and Aristotelian or Theophrastan read Theophrastus's Metaphysics fragment as the continuation of Λ, divided from it by name at the hinge where the account passes from complete to needing more. Forecasts state what each seam should show: Λ answering the fragment's aporiai, the Ethics' types containing the Characters' sketches plus the frame, De anima subordinating the De sensibus survey, and HP sharing HA's connective repertoire in a less varied form. The theses read the Theophrastan function as one operation at two scales and hold that the you of the Elenchi is the I of the fragment, so the corpus contains its own reception.

pages.title: Money as a transmission channel: what the money-form cannot carry
pages.description: Standing claims from the September 2026 semantic-economy papers hold that what money cannot carry loses power over the account, that a monetary scalar cannot preserve a prohibition on its own equivalence, and that the native monetary form preserves only properties invariant under substitution.
